generated_content.domain: Cookie Management and Preferences Tracking for Web Sessions
generated_content.scenario:
The General Assembly of Bizkaia is implementing a comprehensive Web Session and Cookie Management System to enhance user experience and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations. The system aims to manage user sessions and track cookie preferences for both technical and analytical cookies across its web platforms. This initiative is crucial for maintaining secure user sessions, optimizing website functionality, and respecting user privacy preferences.

The platform will enable detailed tracking of user sessions with unique identifiers, manage cookie preferences through user consent, and provide analytics on user interactions with the website. Additionally, it needs to support real-time updates to cookie settings, offer robust reporting tools for compliance audits, and facilitate personalized user experiences by storing user preferences.

A critical component of this system involves managing different types of cookies, such as session, technical, and analytical cookies, each with distinct lifecycles and purposes. The system must be scalable to handle a growing number of users and adaptable to evolving privacy laws. Advanced user roles and permissions will be needed for administrators to manage cookie policies and user data securely.
